Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts

Class Casts

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.casts.Casts
public final class Casts extends Object
Factory for the built-in casts.

of(String) takes a Laravel-style cast string and checks it only when the model first resolves its casts; the typed factories check their arguments at once. Cast strings are listed on of(String).

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static Cast<?> of(String spec)
      Returns a cast for a Laravel-style cast string, parsed later.

      Accepted types, matched after trimming and lower-casing the part before the first :: int, integer, real, float, double, string, bool, boolean, decimal:N (N 0 to 30), decimal:P,S, decimal:P,S,MODE (a RoundingMode name, any case), date, date:F, immutable_date[:F], datetime, datetime:F, immutable_datetime[:F], custom_datetime:F, timestamp, json, array, json:unicode, collection, object, encrypted, encrypted:array, encrypted:json, encrypted:collection, encrypted:object, hashed, binary:uuid, binary:ulid, instant. The argument is kept as written. A format F is a DateTimeFormatter pattern; a PHP format such as Y-m-d compiles with a different meaning.

      Parameters:
      spec - the cast string
      Returns:
      a placeholder the model resolves when it first reads its casts
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if spec is null

    • decimal

      public static Cast<Object> decimal(int precision, int scale)
      Returns the strict decimal:P,S cast, which refuses a value that does not fit.

      Precision is the total digits and scale the digits after the point, as in Blueprint.decimal. A value with more decimals than the scale, or more than precision minus scale integer digits, throws InvalidCastException; the message never carries the value.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range

    • decimal

      public static Cast<Object> decimal(int precision, int scale, RoundingMode mode)
      Returns the strict decimal:P,S,MODE cast, which rounds extra decimals with a mode.

      Integer digits beyond precision minus scale are refused whatever the mode, also when rounding carries into a new digit.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      mode - how extra decimals are rounded; UNNECESSARY refuses them
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range, or mode is null

    • decimalText

      public static Cast<Object> decimalText(int precision, int scale)
      Returns the strict decimal cast for a text column, which keeps every digit on every database.

      The precision and scale rules are those of decimal(int, int). The 15-digit limit that decimal(p, s) applies on SQLite is skipped, because a text column stores the digits as written; use it for long exact values, such as exchange rates, on a string column. SQL sorts, compares and sums such a column as text, so do that math in Java.

      Parameters:
      precision - the total number of digits, 1 to 1000
      scale - the digits after the point, 0 to the precision and at most 30
      Returns:
      a cast reading BigDecimal at the given scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if precision or scale is out of range

    • instant

      public static Cast<Object> instant()
      Returns the instant cast, which stores an Instant whatever the model's TimestampFormat.

      Reads as an Instant from any stored form. Writes truncate to microseconds and accept the same values as datetime(). A bare number is refused. Use it for Blueprint.instant columns other than created_at, updated_at and deleted_at; those columns are also written by the framework in the model's format, so they need TimestampFormat.INSTANT on the model and a cast of this kind fails fast on a text-format model.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing Instant

    • collection

      public static Cast<List<Object>> collection()
      Returns the collection cast: a JSON array column read as a List.

      A stored JSON array reads as a mutable List; changing it in place marks the attribute dirty, as with json(). A null column, an empty string and the JSON literal null read as null. A stored value of another shape, such as an object or a scalar, throws InvalidCastException naming the key and JSON array, never the value. Writes encode the list like json(), a null value stores SQL NULL, and a value that is not a List throws InvalidCastException. An element the codec cannot encode fails the write with a cause of JsonException.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing List values

    • object

      public static Cast<Map<String,Object>> object()
      Returns the object cast: a JSON object column read as a Map.

      A stored JSON object reads as a mutable Map that keeps the stored key order; changing it in place marks the attribute dirty, as with json(). A null column, an empty string and the JSON literal null read as null. A stored value of another shape, such as an array or a scalar, throws InvalidCastException naming the key and JSON object, never the value. Writes encode the map like json(), a null value stores SQL NULL, and a value that is not a Map throws InvalidCastException.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing Map values keyed by String

    • encrypted

      public static Cast<Object> encrypted()
      Returns the encrypted cast: a text column holding encrypter output for a string.

      A read decrypts the stored text with the model's encrypter and returns the String; a write encrypts the text form of the value. A null column reads null and a null value stores SQL NULL, without calling the encrypter. An exception thrown by the encrypter, and a model without an encrypter, reach the caller as an InvalidCastException whose cause is the original exception (same instance). The column must be a text type and cannot be searched with where.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing encrypted strings

    • encrypted

      public static Cast<Object> encrypted(Cast<?> inner)
      Returns an encrypted cast that applies inner to the decrypted text.

      A read decrypts, then reads the text through inner; a write encodes through inner, then encrypts the result. The dirty check decrypts both stored values and compares them through inner. Rules for null, the missing encrypter and failures are those of encrypted(): an exception thrown by the encrypter, and a model without an encrypter, reach the caller as an InvalidCastException whose cause is the original exception (same instance).

      Parameters:
      inner - the json(), jsonUnicode(), collection() or object() cast, or a cast string for one of them
      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing encrypted values of the inner cast's type
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if inner is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if inner is not one of the four casts, or is an invalid cast string

    • hashed

      public static Cast<Object> hashed()
      Returns the hashed cast: a text column holding the model's hash of a written string.

      A write stores the string as given when the model's hasher says it is already hashed and current, refuses it when it is hashed but not current, and otherwise stores the hasher's hash of it. A value that is not a String is refused with an InvalidCastException. A read returns the stored text without calling the hasher. A null value stores SQL NULL and a null column reads null, without calling the hasher. A model without a hasher fails on a non-null write. An exception thrown by the hasher reaches the caller as an InvalidCastException whose cause is the original exception (same instance). The column must be a text type.

      Returns:
      a cast that hashes written strings

    • binaryUuid

      public static Cast<UUID> binaryUuid()
      Returns the binary:uuid cast: a UUID stored as 16 bytes, most significant bits first.

      The column must be binary(), not uuid(). A read needs a byte[] of exactly 16 bytes; a write accepts a UUID only. Any other value fails as an InvalidCastException whose message never holds the value. Search the column with BinaryIds.uuidBytes(UUID). A null value stores SQL NULL.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing UUID values

    • binaryUlid

      public static Cast<String> binaryUlid()
      Returns the binary:ulid cast: a ULID text stored as 16 bytes, most significant byte first.

      The column must be binary(), not uuid(). A read needs a byte[] of exactly 16 bytes and returns the 26-character lower-case text. A write accepts a String of 26 characters in any letter case under the rules of BinaryIds.ulidBytes(String); any other value fails as an InvalidCastException whose message never holds the value. Search the column with BinaryIds.ulidBytes(String). A null value stores SQL NULL.

      Returns:
      a cast reading and writing ULID String values

    • typeName

      public static String typeName(Cast<?> cast)
      Returns the canonical type name of a cast, used by hasCast.

      Built-ins return one name per family whatever alias or argument was used: int, float, string, bool, decimal, date, datetime, timestamp, instant, json, collection, object, encrypted, hashed, binary, enum. Any other cast returns its class name. A cast string is parsed first.

      Parameters:
      cast - the cast
      Returns:
      the type name
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if cast is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if cast is an invalid cast string

    • resolve

      public static Cast<?> resolve(Cast<?> cast)
      Turns a cast string from of(String) into its built-in cast; returns any other cast unchanged.

      Internal to the model layer, which calls it once per model class and wraps a failure in an InvalidCastException naming the model and key. Application code does not need it.

      Parameters:
      cast - the cast
      Returns:
      the resolved cast
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if cast is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if cast is an invalid cast string
